name: sd
description: Intuitive find & replace CLI with regex support and safe preview mode

tools.description: Fast and intuitive find & replace tool with regex support, safer than sed
tools.usage:
sd 'old_text' 'new_text' file.txt # Simple replacement
sd '\d+' 'NUMBER' *.txt # Regex replacement in multiple files
sd --preview 'foo' 'bar' file.txt # Preview changes without applying
sd -s 'literal.string' 'replacement' file.txt # Literal string mode
